format.rules: adaptive paper substrate, no more than two printing inks, active negative space, readable human typography

illustrations.recipe: ruled information sheet, branching argument diagram, crisp grotesk and mono labels
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial study poster titled ARGUMENT MAP: a central claim branches toward evidence and counterpoint, with restrained arrows, annotations and active negative space; cool gray paper, charcoal and signal-red print, visible halftone and slight registration drift, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: annotated journal page, marginalia, airy typographic rhythm
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial illustration titled IDEAS IN THE MARGIN: an open notebook with short handwritten prompts IDEA, EXAMPLE and WHY orbiting a loose thought structure; neutral white paper, mint and warm-charcoal ink, generous whitespace, tactile halftone, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: specimen-like human timeline, calm editorial spacing
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial poster titled LONGER LIVES: a poetic human-life timeline with two older figures, a chair and a growing plant, balancing longevity, care and community; pale-beige paper, mint and warm-charcoal ink, soft halftone, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: contemporary editorial cover, calendar and nesting forms
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial cover titled LATER BEGINNINGS: a calendar, two adult silhouettes and a small nested circle suggest delayed parenthood and personal choice; neutral white paper, cobalt and terracotta ink, bold serif-grotesk hierarchy, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: dense overprint collage, rising blocks and compressed pedestrian scale
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial collage titled CITY PRESSURE: compressed high-rise blocks, tiny commuters, transit lines and one pocket of open space express urban scale and pressure; cool-gray paper, ultramarine and safety-orange ink, energetic overprint, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: object field, garments linked by tags and thread
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial poster titled CLOTHES WE SHARE: a jacket, shirt and shoes connected by thread, tags and repeated human traces, exploring fashion, identity and reuse; neutral white paper, cyan and brick-red ink, modern halftone, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: image field of abstract bars and curves, analytical margin notes
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial information poster titled READ THE CHART: abstract bars, a line curve and comparison marks form a clear visual grammar for trend, compare and change; cool-gray paper, powder-blue and signal-red ink, precise grid with slight print texture, no logos.

illustrations.recipe: still-life gift objects, ribbon as narrative line, warm negative space
illustrations.final_prompt: Original two-ink editorial still life titled WHAT WE GIVE: a wrapped object, flower and note linked by a ribbon, suggesting meaning and memory rather than luxury; pale-beige paper, botanical-green and oxblood ink, tactile grain and active whitespace, no logos.
